claims_reviewed.claim: A Network Finance-advertised Senior Accountant role (PNet 4273960; ref NFR011254-MoD-1) was retrievable on 2026-10-07.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct detail page identifies the advertiser as Network Finance, reference NFR011254-MoD-1, title Senior Accountant | Century City, and PNet publication age as 5 days. Network Finance is the advertiser, not a verified hiring employer.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the agency advert and source facts only.

claims_reviewed.claim: The direct page describes an experienced financial-accounting and management-accounting role.
claims_reviewed.evidence: It lists monthly management accounts, balance-sheet reconciliations, cash-flow reporting, budgeting/forecasting, compliance, audit, financial analysis, internal controls and finance improvement; stated experience is 3–5 years.
claims_reviewed.decision: Classify to Financial Accounting & Reporting, node 8 / Group B; preserve the raw title.

claims_reviewed.claim: The role clears the R420,000 p.a. salary screen.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct Package & Remuneration block states R540,000–R650,000 annually; the lower bound is above R420,000 p.a.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold for provisional salary screening only; package composition is unstated.

claims_reviewed.evidence: The ad describes a well-established/growing organisation based in Century City but does not name the employer. Network Finance is the advertiser.
claims_reviewed.decision: Keep employer and client status unknown; do not infer an employer from location or generic description.

claims_reviewed.claim: The PNet advert is still accepted by the employer.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The PNet page was retrievable and showed Published: 5 days ago on 2026-10-07; no employer-side confirmation or closing date was found.
claims_reviewed.decision: Record as listed at retrieval only; employer-side acceptance remains unknown.

claims_reviewed.claim: PNet card 4273977 (CA(SA), ref NFR011255-MoD-1) is the same requisition or employer.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Both cards identify Network Finance, same agency-side recruiter, Century City/Cape Town, and similar publication age; 4273977 states 1–2 years post-articles and an unnamed Century City organisation, while 4273960 is a Senior Accountant with 3–5 years and an annual range. No employer or requisition linkage is provided.
claims_reviewed.decision: Keep separate; do not merge without recruiter/employer confirmation.

claims_reviewed.claim: This is a Boschendal or Laurium agreed-client opportunity.
claims_reviewed.evidence: No end-employer name or agreed-client relationship appears in the ad.
claims_reviewed.decision: Do not promote to agreed-client priority.

claims_upheld: A retrievable Network Finance PNet advert for Senior Accountant was observed on 2026-10-07.
The direct page displays R540,000–R650,000 annually, whose lower bound clears the R420,000 p.a. screen.
The page describes 3–5 years of experience and core financial-accounting/reporting responsibilities.
claims_downgraded: A recent PNet publication age does not prove the employer remains accepting applications.
Network Finance is the agency advertiser, not a verified end employer.
The same-location CA(SA) card 4273977 is only a possible related opportunity; no merge is supported.
claims_removed: No employer, hiring owner, company email, candidate or personal contact detail is inferred from anonymous employer language.
contradictions: The PNet heading/title and body place the role in Century City, while the structured location metadata says Cape Town: City Bowl; preserve the discrepancy pending confirmation.
unknowns: End-employer identity and employer-side vacancy acceptance are unresolved.
Package composition (base, CTC, bonus or variable pay) is unstated.
PNet location metadata (City Bowl) conflicts with the Century City title/body wording.
Potential relationship to CA(SA) advert 4273977 is unconfirmed.
No employer stakeholder, company-email pattern, target-company map or candidate map is activated while the end employer remains unknown.
The role is not evidenced as a Boschendal or Laurium agreed-client opportunity.
next_research_actions: Identify the hiring employer through reliable agency/employer-origin evidence and verify employer-side vacancy status and package composition.
Resolve the location and possible 4273977 relationship with the recruiter before deduplication.
Do not begin stakeholder/company-email, target-company or candidate mapping until the hiring employer is confirmed or high-confidence.
